jobs.title: Principal Customer Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.


Job Snapshot

Mindtickle is making a bold claim: that it is the AI-native revenue enablement platform, powered by ElevateOS. Bold claims need proof, and they need customers who stay, expand, and advocate. We are looking for a Principal Customer Marketing Manager to build the proof engine behind the story and to drive a unified customer engagement motion across advocacy, voice of customer, lifecycle and retention, and customer communications. This person turns satisfied customers into evidence and into a flywheel that drives adoption, retention, and growth.

You will work closely with customer success, sales, product management, product marketing, and customers directly. Your mandate is to build a proof stack that backs the platform's claims with credible customer, data, and reference evidence, and to own the engagement surfaces that keep customers passionate and growing. You will be measured on the strength and usefulness of the proof system, on advocacy and voice-of-customer signal, and on retention and expansion outcomes.

Responsibilities will include
-
Build the proof engine. Develop a proof stack that backs the platform's claims with customer evidence, before-and-after product proof, and outcome data such as win rate, ramp, manager time saved, and engagement lift, so the company makes strong claims supported by evidence rather than assertions.

-
Own customer advocacy. Grow a base of references, customer stories, reviews, and champions, and turn customer wins into reusable proof across sales, marketing, and analyst relations.

-
Run the voice-of-customer program. Capture structured customer feedback through surveys, councils, and closed-loop processes, and feed insight back into positioning, product, and the customer experience.

-
Drive lifecycle and retention. Own onboarding communications, nurture journeys, in-product moments, and webinars that drive adoption and reduce churn across the customer lifecycle.

-
Coordinate customer communications. Act as air traffic control for post-sale communication, keeping operational email, product updates, and governance coherent so customers get the right message at the right time.

-
Connect proof to revenue motions. Make sure the proof and advocacy you build is actively used in competitive deals, renewals, expansion conversations, and analyst validation.
Desired skills and experience
-
8+ years in customer marketing or a closely related discipline, preferably in B2B SaaS, with a track record of operating as a senior individual contributor who owns outcomes end to end.

-
Customer marketing and advocacy depth. Experience building reference and advocacy programs, customer stories, and a proof system in B2B SaaS.

-
Voice of customer and lifecycle fluency. Hands-on experience with VoC programs and with lifecycle, retention, and customer communication motions that move adoption, retention, and expansion.

-
Evidence and data orientation. Comfort working with outcome data and turning it into credible, defensible proof, with the judgment to know when a claim is sufficiently supported.

-
Cross-functional influence and customer trust. Able to partner across customer success, sales, and product, and to earn the trust of customers directly, in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

-
Operates with high agency in a flat org. This is a senior individual contributor role inside a team going through a transformation. You set your own direction, move without waiting for instruction, and are accountable for the outcome rather than the activity. You can do the work yourself at expert level and design the system that scales it.

-
Maker-checker discipline. You treat AI as the maker for manual and repeatable work and yourself as the checker for strategic judgment and quality. You know which decisions can be delegated to a system and which require a human, and you build accordingly.

-
Comfort with ambiguity and pace. A self-starter who can stand up a proof engine and engagement motion from the ground up and iterate quickly.
Our Culture & Values
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.
Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

Job Snapshot
 
The Senior Manager, BDR – Enterprise is responsible for building and sustaining MindTickle’s Enterprise pipeline engine for the Americas. This leader partners closely with Enterprise Sales to create a predictable, high-quality outbound motion, while fostering a culture rooted in integrity, ownership, and continuous growth. The role requires strong regional understanding of North American enterprise selling and the ability to lead teams operating across geographies.
 

What's in it for you?
- Own Enterprise pipeline creation, quality, and conversion outcomes for the Americas.

- Lead and develop a globally distributed Enterprise BDR team across India and the U.S., with a strong focus on coaching, career progression, and people growth.

- Partner with Enterprise Sales leadership to ensure tight AE–BDR alignment and shared accountability for outcomes.

- Design and execute thoughtful, data-driven outbound strategies across named accounts and buying groups.

- Establish clear operating rhythms, performance expectations, and feedback mechanisms that enable consistency and trust.

- Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, and Product to continuously improve GTM execution.
What Success Looks Like?
- A predictable, respected Enterprise pipeline motion that Enterprise Sales trusts.

- A team that grows in capability, confidence, and career readiness year over year.

- A culture where accountability and empathy coexist, and integrity guides decisions.
We’d love to hear from you, if you:
- 10+ years in B2B SaaS revenue roles, including end-to-end quota-carrying sales experience prior to moving into Sales or BDR leadership.

- Experience supporting and scaling Enterprise sales motions in North America / Americas.

- Demonstrated ability to lead teams across geographies and time zones with clarity and fairness.

- Strong judgment, executive presence, and a collaborative leadership style.

- Solid understanding of Enterprise deal dynamics, multi-stakeholder selling, and AE–BDR partnership models.
